events.description: 38. NOTATION ORDER: Defendant indicates in his Response (ECF No. 37) that he intends to separately move for a protective order. Defendant is ADVISED that a party seeking to file a discovery motion must first seek an informal discovery conference as required by Section II.C. of Magistrate Judge Shimeall's General Standing Orders on Civil Trial Procedures, and this Court's May 4, 2026 Preliminary Pretrial Order. If the parties remain at an impasse, they are directed to email Magistrate Judge Shimealls Chambers at Shimeall_Chambers@ohsd.uscourts.gov to arrange an informal discovery conference. If, a dispute remains after the informal discovery conference, the Court may direct the parties to file briefing as necessary to resolve the dispute. Signed by Magistrate Judge S.
